Interface ElementSpec

public interface ElementSpec
An element whose position a layout helper (Row, Column) computes: its size now, the element itself when at(int, int) is called with the computed position.

MenuKit's own elements need no spec: build them with their builder and hand the element to Row.add/Column.add, which wraps it through of(PanelElement) and moves it with setChildPosition (§0066: the spec() factories folded into the builders). Implement this interface for a custom element that can only be constructed once its position is known.
